function Source(x, uq, v, w, eta, mu, t)
  output_size(s) = 4;
  s[0] = 0.0;
  s[1] = 0.0;
  s[2] = 0.0;
  s[3] = 0.0;
end

function Tdfunc(x, uq, v, w, eta, mu, t)
  output_size(m) = 4;
  m[0] = 1.0;
  m[1] = 1.0;
  m[2] = 1.0;
  m[3] = 1.0;
end

function Ubou(x, uq, v, w, uhat, n, tau, eta, mu, t)
  output_size(ub) = 4;
  ub[0] = 0.0;
  ub[1] = 0.0;
  ub[2] = 0.0;
  ub[3] = 0.0;
end

function Fbou(x, uq, v, w, uhat, n, tau, eta, mu, t)
  output_size(fb) = 4;
  fb[0] = 0.0;
  fb[1] = 0.0;
  fb[2] = 0.0;
  fb[3] = 0.0;
end

function FbouHdg(x, uq, v, w, uhat, n, tau, eta, mu, t)
  output_size(fb) = 20;
  fb[0] = mu[4]-uhat[0];
  fb[1] = mu[5]-uhat[1];
  fb[2] = mu[6]-uhat[2];
  fb[3] = mu[7]-uhat[3];
  fb[4] = uq[0]-uhat[0];
  fb[5] = uq[1]-uhat[1];
  fb[6] = uq[2]-uhat[2];
  fb[7] = uq[3]-uhat[3];
  fb[8] = uq[0]-uhat[0];
  fb[9] = -uhat[1];
  fb[10] = -uhat[2];
  fb[11] = -uhat[3]+(mu[8]*mu[10]*uhat[0])/mu[9];
  fb[12] = uq[0]-uhat[0];
  fb[13] = -uhat[1];

function Initu(x, eta, mu)
  output_size(ui) = 4;
  ui[0] = mu[4];
  ui[1] = mu[5];
  ui[2] = mu[6];
  ui[3] = mu[7];
end

function VisScalars(x, uq, v, w, eta, mu, t)
  output_size(s) = 5;
  s[0] = uq[0];
  s[1] = uq[1]/uq[0];
  s[2] = uq[2]/uq[0];
  s[3] = uq[3];
  ke = 0.5*(uq[1]*s[1] + uq[2]*s[2]);
  p = (mu[0]-1.0)*(s[3] - ke);
  s[4] = p/((mu[0]-1.0)*s[0]);
end
